'''2010 Malastare Regionals Rob Montgomery LS Rescue The Princess''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Rob Montgomery]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' RTP / SI AEM
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
